title: gate-save-load-parity
liveReferenceCommandApplicability: N/A — gate-save-load-parity is a pure deterministic bun test gate, intentionally NOT registered in LIVE_REFERENCE_TEST_PATHS and capturing no live Win32 window, so the conditional `bun run plan_final/test-live-reference.ts ...` verification command does not apply to this step.
resolution: Vanilla save/load is a deterministic serialization round-trip (G_DoSaveGame writes fixed-order archive sections; G_DoLoadGame + P_UnArchive* restore exactly), so byte/state parity after restore is well-posed reference-independently even though the read-only capture-live-save-load-roundtrip.json fixture is an abstract-contract-pending-live-reference-run (live framebuffer/audio/state hashes + every required reference replay/hash surface explicitly pending-live-reference-capture; no captured oracle). Same owner-#5 class delegated for 13-003 and applied 13-004/13-005. The gate asserts, each zero-difference: (1) the read-only roundtrip fixture is a well-formed deterministic bun run doom.ts contract (schemaVersion 1, strictly-increasing ordinals, tic-monotone expectedTrace covering the required clean-launch→start-e1m1→open-save-menu→write-save-slot-zero→mutate-live-state-after-save→open-load-menu→load-save-slot-zero→verify-restored-frame actions, stable 64-hex abstractTraceSha256), reparsed twice → byte-identical; (2) the committed vanilla round-trip-plan contract (compare-save-load-roundtrip-oracle) pins the canonical write-read-write / read-write-read / state-save-load-state step sequences; (3) the committed src/save engine round-trips the canonical valid savegame sections (exact replicas of the committed test/save BASE_* fixtures) with write-read-write BYTE parity (compareVanillaSaveBytes matches for players/mobjs/world archives + the whole writeVanillaSaveGame buffer incl. EOF + vanilla-limit) and state-save-load-state STATE parity (read-back deep-equals input) + header round-trip, all reproducible across two independent runs. For a deterministic engine, byte+state parity after restore entails the contracted frame/audio parity after restore. Focused gate PASSED 4/4 (0 fail, 52 expect()s); tsc 0; format clean.
